summary: Pass with escalation (bounce cap of 2 spent). Every blocking fault from bounce 2 is verified fixed: the vestigial pill notch is gone (card bottom edge measures flat at y=1809 across x=600-930 in variants 1/2/3/3b, and the 52pt/56pt discs breach it at a measured 41-42% above the edge, matching the 42/58 overhang law); option 2's arc now uses .strokeBorder (outer silhouette matches option 1 at every angle sampled, r=77.6-78.6, zero bleed) and fades smoothly (full-bright -45 to +45 degrees, ramping to noise by +/-70, correctly centred on top); option 3b was produced and its 3.04:1 inner-fill-vs-ground claim is accurate; the footer's rim-highlight and card-join corrections landed. All intake desirables are satisfied and glyph contrast measures 6.37-9.01:1. Four residual issues ship unfixed and are recorded for the user: (1) the detail crops clip the top ~26% of the button, removing option 2's arc core entirely (zero full-brightness arc pixels in variant2_crop.png) and most of option 4's scoop, so those two options must be judged from their full frames instead; (2) the sheet leaves ~39% of its canvas empty to the right of a left-anchored 2x2 grid, and frames shrank from 584px to 460px vs the prior revision; (3) option 3b's fill lift drops its glyph contrast to 2.98:1 and its ring-vs-inner separation to 1.98:1, collapsing the two-tone read it exists to test, and the sheet states only the favourable ratio; (4) option 4's card is 25pt taller than the other four, so two variables move in that panel. None would have justified a third bounce; all are recorded honestly in critique.md with specific fixes.
